title: Qt: IPv4 aggregation for Endpoints/Conversations
description:
Reuse of the subnets config file to allow the aggregation of IPv4
traffic in the endpoints/conversations statistics dialogs.

Closes #19481. Related to  #9230, #16795.

Notes for the approver:
- This reuses the _subnets_ file stored in any user's profile directory but not its associated preference _Resolve network (IP) addresses_ . Instead, a new IPv4 protocol preference called _Aggregate subnets in Conversations Dialog_ is added, then both behaviors (in main window & conversations dialog) are independent.
- _hashipv4_ struct is extended then we can track/store the CIDR notation of an IPv4 address
- add a new function for managing the conversation table
- some minor changes then main window filters and conversations dialog behaviors are consistent, and some elements which aren't _static_ anymore as they need a larger scope
